reference_attribute_specularconstant_blo.reason: White specular highlights require a non-white backdrop to test their alpha and intensity; both renderers use the same neutral gray.

reference_attribute_specularexponent_blo.reason: White specular highlights require a non-white backdrop to test their alpha and intensity; both renderers use the same neutral gray.

reference_attribute_spreadmethod_block_2.reason: WebKit renders pad, reflect, and repeat identically for this radial gradient with a nonzero focal radius. IJSVGPaintOrderWebKitTests/testRadialSpreadWithFocalRadiusMatchesExplicitStops verifies both spread modes against WebKit using the equivalent zero-radius cone and explicitly expanded stops. SVG 2 requires the radial spread modes; this exception is limited to this exact fixture.

reference_element_marker_block_5_1.reason: WebKit renders the context-fill and context-stroke marker circles with the default black fill and no stroke. SVG 2 requires the paint of the referencing path. IJSVGPaintOrderWebKitTests/testMarkerContextPaintMatchesExplicitColors verifies the same geometry and colors against WebKit using markers with explicit paints. This exception is limited to this exact fixture.

reference_attribute_surfacescale_block_2.reason: At the comparison backing scale, WebKit scales the point light position but leaves surfaceScale in device pixels, changing the effective light height. IJSVGPaintOrderWebKitTests/testLightingSurfaceScaleMatchesEquivalentLightHeight verifies flat surfaces against WebKit with the equivalent zero surface height and reduced light Z. IJSVGFilterTests/testLightingSurfaceHeightIsIndependentOfRenderScale checks matching sample positions at two render scales. This exception is limited to this exact fixture.

reference_attribute_stroke_linecap_block.reason: WebKit paints a diamond together with the square cap on the zero length subpath. SVG 2 requires only the centered square. IJSVGPaintOrderWebKitTests/testPointSubpathCapsMatchExplicitShapes verifies caps against explicit WebKit rectangles and circles, including rotated and non scaling strokes. This exception is limited to this exact fixture.

reference_attribute_fill_block_3_1.reason: This fixture repeats the context fill and context stroke marker behavior already covered by reference_element_marker_block_5_1. WebKit uses default marker paints. IJSVGPaintOrderWebKitTests/testMarkerContextPaintMatchesExplicitColors verifies the required paints against explicit WebKit colors. This exception is limited to this exact fixture.

reference_attribute_stroke_block_3_1.reason: This fixture is identical to reference_attribute_fill_block_3_1 and repeats the context marker difference already covered by reference_element_marker_block_5_1. IJSVGPaintOrderWebKitTests/testMarkerContextPaintMatchesExplicitColors verifies the required paints against explicit WebKit colors. This exception is limited to this exact fixture.

reference_attribute_in_block_1_1.reason: The fixture does not enable background accumulation. SVG 1.1 defines BackgroundImage as transparent black in this case. WebKit instead multiplies the source with itself. IJSVGPaintOrderWebKitTests/testBackgroundBlendWithoutEnabledBackdropMatchesTransparentInput verifies the result against an explicit transparent input. This exception is limited to this exact fixture.

reference_attribute_path_block_2_1.reason: WebKit does not render text using the inline path attribute on textPath. IJSVGPaintOrderWebKitTests/testInlineTextPathMatchesReferencedPath verifies the same geometry and text against a WebKit textPath with an equivalent referenced path. This exception is limited to this exact fixture.

reference_attribute_side_block_2_1.reason: WebKit ignores side=right on textPath and paints both strings on the left side. IJSVGPaintOrderWebKitTests/testTextPathRightSideMatchesReversedPath verifies right side placement against an explicitly reversed WebKit path. This exception is limited to this exact fixture.

reference_attribute_stitchtiles_block_2_.reason: WebKit omits the translated tile origin from its stitch wrap coordinates. testTranslatedStitchedTurbulencePreservesInteriorNoise and testTranslatedStitchedNoisePreservesPermutationPeriod cover translated coordinates and complete tiles including wrap boundaries for both noise types and multiple octave counts. This exception is limited to this exact fixture.

reference_element_femerge_block_1_1.reason: The unitless object bounding box filter dimensions create a 10000 by 20000 region. WebKit reduces the source resolution to fit its surface limit. IJSVG preserves resolution by bounding the finite offset and blur coverage. IJSVGPaintOrderWebKitTests/testLargeFilterRegionsPreserveSourceResolution verifies both merge variants against equivalent WebKit filters with ordinary region sizes. This exception is limited to this exact fixture.

reference_attribute_dominant_baseline_bl.reason: WebKit does not implement text-top here. testBaselineExamplesMatchExplicitReferenceBaselines compares the unchanged IJSVG fixture against the equivalent explicit text-before-edge reference. This exception is limited to this exact fixture.

tutorials_svg_from_scratch_texts_block_2.reason: WebKit loses the inherited hanging baseline on the child span. testBaselineExamplesMatchExplicitReferenceBaselines compares the unchanged IJSVG fixture against an explicitly inherited WebKit baseline. This exception is limited to this exact fixture.

tutorials_svg_from_scratch_texts_block_3.reason: WebKit loses the inherited hanging baseline on textPath. testBaselineExamplesMatchExplicitReferenceBaselines compares the unchanged IJSVG fixture against an explicitly inherited WebKit baseline. This exception is limited to this exact fixture.

reference_attribute_xchannelselector_blo.reason: WebKit samples displacement at integer pixels and does not linearize the embedded image map here. IJSVG uses continuous bilinear sampling. testDisplacementExampleImageGeometry verifies the embedded map geometry. testDisplacedTextMatchesEquivalentOffsets covers all channels with positive and negative fractional offsets, alongside the existing channel and color space controls. This exception is limited to this exact fixture.

reference_attribute_ychannelselector_blo.reason: This fixture shares the image maps and text geometry of the xChannelSelector example. WebKit integer displacement sampling and image map color space differ. testDisplacementExampleImageGeometry and testDisplacedTextMatchesEquivalentOffsets retain geometry and channel coverage alongside the existing color space controls. This exception is limited to this exact fixture.

reference_element_switch_block_1_1.reason: WebKit selects en-US for an en-GB preference in this regional switch. testSwitchExampleMatchesRegionalReference verifies the original IJSVG fixture against the explicit regional text. Quartz switch tests retain independent language matching coverage. This exception is limited to this exact fixture.

reference_element_tspan_block_2_1.reason: Automatic kerning across span fragments and glyph rasterization differ between WebKit and Core Text. testSpanExampleCharacterPositionsWithoutKerning verifies the advance and every character position against WebKit with explicit font-kerning:none. This is a geometry control rather than a pixel comparison. This exception is limited to this exact fixture.
